title: Liverpool's 2005 final XI
brief: Name the ten outfield players who started for Liverpool against AC Milan in the 2005 Champions League final (25 May 2005), when they drew 3-3 and won on penalties. The goalkeeper (Jerzy Dudek) is left out.

notes.Vladimir Smicer: Vladimir Smicer came on as a substitute in the 2005 final, so he did not start.
notes.Dietmar Hamann: Dietmar Hamann came on as a substitute in the 2005 final, so he did not start.
notes.Djibril Cisse: Djibril Cisse came on as a substitute in the 2005 final, so he did not start.

checks: Starting XI, positions and shirt numbers from the team sheet on the final's Wikipedia page; the same eleven players and shirt numbers are on the Transfermarkt match report. Positions are Wikipedia's.
